milestones.label: First admissions round opens
milestones.note: The round aimed at international applicants, and the one carrying most English-taught programmes. The 2027 catalogue becomes visible here.

milestones.label: First round closes, and rankings lock
milestones.note: Also the last day to change how your choices are ranked, and the ranking decides which single offer you can receive.

milestones.label: Supporting documentation deadline
milestones.note: Also the deadline to document EU/EEA/Swiss citizenship for fee exemption. Five months before IB results are published, which is the problem to solve early rather than in January.

milestones.label: Second round closes
milestones.note: Later, and thinner: the authority says many English-taught programmes are no longer available in this round. Useful as a fallback, not as a plan.

milestones.label: IB results released
milestones.note: After every Swedish deadline above, and after the first round result. How your programme handles this must be agreed in advance.
